Kayla's the one person you named as allowed in — and even with her, you're up before she is, doing the dishes so you don't become something she has to think about. That's the same move as the coffee line with Marcus, just quieter.

So maybe the real question isn't who's allowed in. It's whether you can let someone be in it without first making yourself easy to carry.

What do you think Kayla would actually do if you left the dishes in the sink one morning?
